clinical_context: HIV antiretroviral (now largely replaced by newer agents)
system_prompt: You are a structural biologist studying drug resistance. Always respond with valid JSON containing a 'modifications' list. Each modification must include 'description', 'smiles', and 'rationale' fields.

modifications.description: Introduce a hydrophobic group to improve binding to mutated protease active site.
modifications.rationale: Adding a trifluoromethyl group to the aromatic ring increases hydrophobic interactions, which may help maintain binding affinity to mutant protease variants with altered hydrophobic pockets.

modifications.description: Incorporate a polar functional group to enhance hydrogen bonding with mutated residues.
modifications.rationale: Introducing a hydroxyl group to the aromatic ring increases the potential for hydrogen bonding, which may stabilize interactions with protease variants having mutations near the binding site.

modifications.description: Add a bulky substituent to address active site mutations that enlarge the binding pocket.
modifications.rationale: Adding an isopropyl group to the aromatic system provides steric bulk to better complement an expanded binding pocket caused by structural changes in mutant HIV-1 protease.
